changes: DM history APIs accept the existing request cancellation guard, AbortSignal and timeout options. Store history reads use a 15-second network timeout; tail/around reads also pass their abort signal.

History network/decryption exceptions no longer leave tail loading or around-message claims stuck. Cleanup checks request ownership, so a stale failure cannot release a newer request or change its loading indicator. Concurrent channel loads retain the global indicator until the final owned request finishes.

Current failures produce a localized Turkish/English error toast; pagination retains its existing messages and can be retried. Around-message API failure is not treated as a missing target: 404/confirmed missing targets retain the existing fallback, while other failures do not silently load a different history window. No automatic message POST replay was added.
verification: Focused API/store suites passed: 2 files / 51 tests. Tests cover request-option propagation, tail/around network and decryption errors, stale failure suppression, concurrent loaders and older/newer-page retry after errors.
TypeScript tsc -b, targeted ESLint and targeted git diff --check passed.

Full client regression suite passed: 231 files / 2273 tests in 46.99s. Vite production build passed in 700ms with existing build warnings. Coverage validation passed: 33 references / 261 behaviors; acceptance remains incomplete.
remaining: Browser retry ergonomics and real network/disconnect acceptance remain open. The network timeout does not impose a timeout on cryptographic decryption or local IndexedDB work.
Per-message WS edit/delete ordering, monotonic cache-write arbitration and cross-tab cache/session atomicity are not addressed by this change.
Overall P0-P11 remains incomplete. No commit, push, merge, Windows package or production release performed.
